name: Environmental Management, Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Environmental Studies — Department of Environmental Management

deadline.value: Fall 2027 International Admissions Guide has not yet been published by SNU Office of Admissions (Spring 2027 international online application ran July 6-9, 2026).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Central SNU Graduate Admissions Guide and the department's English pages do not state whether pre-application supervisor contact is required.

funding.value: Competitive internal GSES Research Assistant (RA) scholarships (full tuition waiver + stipend for one student per semester per professor), Development Fund tuition waivers, alumni/overseas student scholarships, plus central GSFS/SPF fellowships.
funding.quote: Research Assistant(RA) Scholarship | Full waiver of tuition and scholarship for one student per semester per professor | Development Fund Special Scholarship | Full tuition waiver scholarship from Seoul National University Development Fund (one student per semester)

also.quote: SNU President Fellowship Program (SPF) | Tuition fee: full tuition exemption for a maximum of 6 semesters | Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS) | Tuition fee: full tuition exemption for a maximum of 4 semesters

entry_route.value: Offers Master's and Doctoral programs only (no Combined Master's & Doctoral track in GSES); Doctoral entry requires a master's degree or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: 1) Master’s / Combined Master’s & Doctoral Programs: a bachelor’s degree or higher | 2) Doctoral Programs: a master’s degree or higher | Environmental Management ◯ ◯

notes: Department of Environmental Management (newly separated from Environmental Planning in 2025) focuses on climate change and carbon neutrality. Additional environmental Ph.D. tracks exist at Graduate School of Public Health (Environmental Health Sciences, M/D) and CALS (Forest Environmental Science, M/D; Agricultural & Forest Meteorology, M/D).
